correctness.rationale: For the explicit family, the coefficient energy is exactly \(|x_1|^2+\sum_{n\ge2}|x_n|^2/n^2\), which lies between \(\|K^*x\|^2\) and \(\|x\|^2\). The scaling gives the orthonormal basis, while \(y^{(m)}=m^{-1}e_m\in R(T_F)\) satisfies \(\|D_ay^{(m)}\|/\|y^{(m)}\|=m\). The replacement equivalence follows exactly from boundedness of \(A=D_aT_F\) and Douglas range inclusion. The closed-range repair follows from the bounded inverse of \(T_F\) on \(\ker(T_F)^\perp\).

value.rationale: The result corrects a published operator characterization at the point where K-frame theory differs structurally from ordinary frame theory. The counterexample remains valid for closed-range \(K\), rules out a natural attempted repair, and the exact replacement identifies the correct bounded object \(D_aT_F\). The additional closed-analysis-range condition explains precisely when the published argument becomes valid.
